Name: Build On Any Map
Author: sexynes
Description:
Allows players to build on any outdoor vanilla map from Robin's shop, add animals to the coop/barn, and plant in dirt areas.

For custom maps, if map and location designation codes are known, they can be entered into the config to build on. Leave config entries blank if designations are not correct or known. 

[size=5]Requirements [/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Some locations require someone to have visited [/size]
[*][size=3]If cabins are built on a map, do not turn off that config unless there are no cabins [/size]
[*][size=3]Once a map is planted on, do not turn off that config unless crops are unsubstantial [/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]Recommendations [/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ mod (allows more areas to display in building menus) [/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28456]Craftable Carpenter Construction Shop[/url]﻿ mod [/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23526]Buildable Wizard Book[/url]﻿ mod [/size]
[*][size=3]Avoid building on NPC paths [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Additional Config Features [/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Maps can be plantable [/size]
[*][size=3]Grass can spread on dirt areas [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Custom Map Designation Codes  [/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Map designation code: [/size]
[size=3] ﻿1. Sometimes, it is the same as the location designation code. 
﻿2. Sometimes, it is in this format: [mod's unique ID]_[map file name]. 
﻿3. Sometimes, it is in this format: Custom_[map file name].
﻿4. Otherwise, search mod's code for what the location uses for its MapPath or what the map is loaded as. [/size][*][size=3]Location designation code: [/size]
[size=3] ﻿1. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿, type "whereami" into SMAPI. 
﻿2. If you have ConsoleCommands, type "patch summary" into SMAPI, scroll to Global Tokens near the top, and find LocationName. 
﻿3. Otherwise, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url]﻿. 
[/size][/list]
